$comment: T01 frozen mode contract, machine-readable. Values were decided by the project owner on 2026-09-26 and recorded in docs/mode-contract.md. Downstream tests read these; do not re-derive.

walls.$comment: Zero-based [row][col] coordinates of the centred 2x2 block.

spawnWeights.$comment: Every mode: 90% low value, 10% high value. Modes differ only in board and merge table.

fibonacci.rule: Compact toward the move direction, then scan pairs from the target edge inward. A merge fires when the table matches. A merge product cannot merge again in the same move. Score increases by the product value.

examples.why: Scan from the left edge: 1+2=3 is the product; the remaining 3 falls in.
Scan from the right edge: 2+3=5 is the product; the remaining 1 stays left.
1+1=2 is a product, so it cannot merge again with the trailing 2.
Two independent pairs merge; neither product merges again.
Scan from the left edge: 2+3=5 is the product; the trailing 5 falls in.
Scan from the right edge: 3+5=8 is the product; the 2 stays left.

settlement.$comment: Reaching the target is a milestone, not an end. Only 'ended' writes a record, exactly once, to the style active at settlement.

measurement.degradationPath: replayable operation log plus checkpoints, preserving undo-to-start
measurement.onWriteFailure: keep in-page undo, warn that a refresh may not resume
